glyph.isekai_mahou.anti_magic.desc: Signature enchantment, SELF ONLY. Levels I–V: spell damage drops 45/60/72/84/100%% (up to 70%% against bosses) and harmful magical effects fail (35–100%%). In exchange your offensive spells deal 60–35%% damage and upkeep costs resource per second. Recasting raises the level; sneak + F ends it. Invert: Silence and disenchant on the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.eight_gates.desc: Transformation (Enchanter origin, self only). Each cast opens the NEXT gate (+1 per Amplify): Opening, Healing, Life, Pain, Limit, View, Wonder and Death. Each gate grants huge power (melee damage +10%% → +160%%, speed, attack, techniques +6%% per gate) and costs health to open (4%% → 15%%); from the 4th on, health drains every second and from the 6th your punches release an area shockwave. Limit: Lesson 3 gates; Enchanter 3 + rank (all 8 at rank V). The 8th lasts 10 s and explodes around you; when it closes you are left at 1 health, exhausted, and the gates lock for 60 s — it never kills. 20 s (Extend). Invert: seals the enemy's gates (weakness, slowness, Exposed).
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_aegis.desc: Enchantment. +3 armor, +1 toughness and +8%% knockback resistance per level. 30 s. Invert: Exposed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_gear.desc: Enchantment. Temporarily enchants the target's weapon, tools and armor (items glow): +1 damage per level (+0.75 on projectiles), −5%% damage taken and +25%% mining speed per level. 45 s. Invert: Exposed and Weakness.
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_haste.desc: Enchantment. +8%% speed and +10%% attack speed per level, stacking up to the cap. 30 s. Invert: Slowness and Mining Fatigue on the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_imbue.desc: Enchantment. The spell's ELEMENT goes into the target's weapon: each melee hit deals +1.5 damage per level (Arcane +2) and the element's touch (burns, soaks, chills, shocks, weighs, pushes, exposes, corrupts). Build it with an element glyph. 30 s. Invert: disenchants the enemy (removes enchantments and one good effect).
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_link.desc: Enchanter origin form. Threads of light carry the effects to you, your PARTY (no aiming or line of sight needed), your pets and nearby allies. Range 24 (Enchanter 36). Up to 2 allies +2 per Split +1 every 3 Circles (max 7). Harmful effects don't hit allies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_might.desc: Enchantment (Enchanter origin). +2 melee damage per level; each application adds +1 level (+1 per Amplify) up to the cap (3; Enchanter 4–5). 30 s (Extend; much longer for the Enchanter). Invert: Weakness on the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_overdrive.des: Enchantment. For 8 s: +20%% damage, +15%% attack speed and +8%% speed per level. When it ends comes Exhaustion (Slowness and Weakness). Invert: forced Exhaustion on the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_sovereign.des: Enchanter G form (ultimate). Opens a giant inscription circle (radius 10, 15 s; bigger and longer for the Enchanter) that pulses the effects on everyone inside every second — enchantments stacking on allies, the rest on enemies — and is an ANTI-MAGIC field: enemy spells fail inside and magic projectiles dissolve (bosses resist).
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchant_vitality.desc: Enchantment. Heals 2 at once and regenerates every 2 s (more per level). 20 s. Invert: Bleeding.
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchanter_gear_fourth: Transformation (Enchanter origin, self only). The body INFLATES: size ×1.6, melee damage +120%%, armor +8, toughness, +20 health (healed at once), reach +1.5 blocks and a spring jump; every punch is a cannon that hits everyone around (60%%). Needs 15%% of your resource and drains 3%% per second; exhaustion afterwards. 20 s (Extend). Replaces Second Gear. Invert: a cannon punch on the enemy (high damage and launch).
glyph.isekai_mahou.enchanter_gear_second: Transformation (Enchanter origin, self only; a tribute to the rubber pirate). Blood pumped faster turns into steam: speed +35%%, attack speed +40%%, melee damage +25%%, jump and safe fall (Amplify adds). Costs 4%% of health plus 1%% every 2 s. 20 s (Extend; longer for the Enchanter). Replaces Fourth Gear. Invert: a jet of scalding steam (damage and blindness).
Signature enchantment, SELF ONLY. Consumes ALL your resource and locks it at zero: you cannot cast anything while it lasts. In exchange, per level: strength, speed, attack speed, armor, health, jump, −5%% damage taken; night vision and marked enemies; invisible to magical detection and immune to domains' Sure Hit (a boss domain deals only 30%%). 45 s. Sneak + F ends it. Invert: drains the enemy's mana and silences them.
glyph.isekai_mahou.kaioken.desc: Transformation (Enchanter origin, self only). A red aura multiplies the body: each cast climbs a step (+1 per Amplify) — ×2, ×3 (rank III) and ×10 (rank V). Melee damage ×2/×3/×10, techniques ×1.5/×2/×5.5 and more speed; costs 5%%/8%%/15%% of health to climb and DRAINS 2%%/4%%/10%% of health per second. If health reaches 1, the body gives out: Kaioken breaks and exhaustion follows. 15 s (×10: 5 s; Extend). Invert: overheats the enemy (damage and Burning).
glyph.isekai_mahou.ultra_instinct.desc: Transformation (Enchanter origin; on you or an ally). Silver aura: the body dodges 3 attacks ON ITS OWN (+2 per Amplify; Enchanter +1 +rank/2, max 12) — hits, projectiles and spells with an author — sidestepping them. After a dodge, the next hit within 2 s is a counter (+50%%). Bosses still land 50%% of the time. 8 s (Extend; Enchanter +10%% per rank). Invert: clouds the enemy's instincts (nausea, slowness, weakness).
item.isekai_mahou.enchanter_codex.desc: The Enchanter's notebook: every page is an enchantment engraved on their own body.
item.isekai_mahou.enchanter_gauntlets.de: Light gauntlets for those who fight with their own enchanted body. Quick punches that conduct enchantments.
legend.isekai_mahou.enchanter_boundman.d: The muscle-inflated body with Aegis on top and extra time: cannon fists that hit everyone around.
legend.isekai_mahou.enchanter_celestial_: Heavenly Restriction at a high level and long duration: all mana becomes body — absurd strength, speed and senses, invisible to magic.
legend.isekai_mahou.enchanter_death_gate: Gate of Death: Night of the Dragon
Opens four gates at once, with Might: at Rite rank V it reaches the Eighth Gate — 10 s of maximum power and the shockwave that topples everything around. Then, 1 health.
legend.isekai_mahou.enchanter_emperor_fi: Your next punch carries an inverted, amplified Anti-Magic: the target is silenced and loses enchantments and good effects. For the fighter who lets no spell finish.
legend.isekai_mahou.enchanter_kaioken_x1: Climbs Kaioken three steps at once (×10 at rank V) together with Overdrive. Five seconds to end the fight.
legend.isekai_mahou.enchanter_sovereign_: The Sovereign's Sanctum, enlarged, pulsing amplified Might, Celerity, Aegis and Vitality on the whole party while enemy spells dissolve.

message.isekai_mahou.enchanter.welcome_h: Use the Codex of Inscription to see the Rite (5 ranks). Enchant yourself, enchant your party — and fight with the gauntlets.
